design: Same adopted H200, fresh optimizer, original1200-step recipe at LR.0025 on MPS. Two warmup numerical updates, cProfile around the third Context.step, synchronize timing boundaries. No model hooks or source changes.
interpretation_limits: One instrumented early-training step; not a quality evaluation, scientific campaign or sustained-throughput benchmark.
cProfile measures Python-visible wall time, including synchronization waits and instrumentation; it is not GPU-kernel attribution.
Cumulative times overlap and cannot be summed. Compare self time or disjoint call paths carefully.
Fresh optimizer/early-stage profile has no averaging snapshot; later training and serving may differ.
No holdout scored, no checkpoint output, no source/model/guard mutation, no repeat of closed fixtures.
purpose: After padding removal failed exact numerical equivalence, measure remaining overhead in the adopted unchanged implementation rather than infer the next optimization from static counts.
role_audit: Exact rg search over research/research_state JSON,JSONL,Python,Markdown returned no occurrences before freeze. Model initializer roles reconstruct only accepted checkpoint identity; three numerical profiling updates use fresh paired sampler roles.
